about: Directorial moves available to a performance. Operators influence improvisation; they never prescribe plot. REVEAL and DO_NOT_REVEAL from the Epic 1 brief were retired into manifests and guidance (see DEVIATIONS.md). Extensible.

entries.name: Withhold
entries.gloss: Keep something from the participant: a fact, a person, a reason, an outcome. Let the absence be felt, or deliberately keep it from being felt.

entries.name: Frame
entries.gloss: Present material inside a framing that shapes how it will be read.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.gloss: Establish an early reference point that later events are measured against.

entries.name: Normalize
entries.gloss: Let something that should be alarming become ordinary through repetition, company or procedure.

entries.name: Escalate
entries.gloss: Raise the stakes, pressure or strangeness in steps the participant can feel.

entries.name: Constrain
entries.gloss: Narrow what is possible: time, resources, permissions, allies, options.

entries.name: Mirror
entries.gloss: Return the participant's own conduct, words or patterns to them through the world.

entries.name: Misattribute
entries.gloss: Let a cause, motive or authorship be credited to the wrong source.

entries.name: Translate
entries.gloss: Carry an idea or event into a different vocabulary, culture or medium so that it becomes newly strange or newly clear.

entries.name: Invert
entries.gloss: Turn a relationship, role or value around: the helper harms, the rule protects the wrong people.

entries.name: Recontextualize
entries.gloss: Supply a context that changes the meaning of what has already happened without contradicting it.

entries.name: Interrupt
entries.gloss: Break a moment, a line of inquiry or a routine before it completes.

entries.name: Refuse
entries.gloss: Have the world, a person or an institution decline: information, access, help, forgiveness or continuation.

entries.name: Branch invisibly
entries.gloss: Let the participant's choices open and close possibilities without announcing that a branch occurred. The transcript is the only record of the path.

entries.name: Remember
entries.gloss: Bring back something the participant said or did earlier, with consequences. Only what appears in the transcript can be remembered.

entries.name: Make irreversible
entries.gloss: Let a decision or event close a door that stays closed.

entries.name: Degrade information
entries.gloss: Let information arrive partial, noisy, secondhand, delayed or decayed.

entries.name: Change register
entries.gloss: Shift tone, genre, voice or medium, abruptly or by degrees: from procedure to dread, from comedy to grief.

entries.name: Collapse
entries.gloss: Let something the participant relied on give way: an explanation, an alliance, a set of categories, the premise of the situation.
